title: Processes
description: Reusable procedures: API calls, loops, decisions, approvals, checks and browser steps. Every save creates a new version.

import.title: Import process (YAML or JSON)
import.hint: Paste a definition or load one file to review it first. Selecting several files imports each of them directly (e.g. the files in the repository's examples/processes folder).

bundle.hint: A bundle (JSON, created with "Export all processes & dashboards") contains several processes and dashboards. Credentials and platforms are never part of a bundle.

manualTemplate.name: New manual procedure
manualTemplate.description: A procedure of manual steps: people carry out each step, tick its checklist, enter its fields and add evidence. Steps marked so are verified by a second person.

manualTemplate.prepareItem1: Announce the work to the people affected
manualTemplate.prepareItem2: Have the tools and spare parts at hand
